findings.description: reviews/converge-result.json records converged=false, reason=quorum_lost, and summary=null, while its note and plan-findings.md claim that full consensus was obtained. Machine consumers must treat the authoritative result as failed, so the plan has not passed its convergence gate. Regenerate a compact but truthful successful/adjudicated result or complete another convergence run.

The four codebase-analysis scenarios added during round-2 adjudication—Coverage footer shape, Target resolution precedence, Unique name resolves, and Direction both labels sections—are absent from task 1.1's test scope and Spec scenarios list. Nothing in the implementation plan therefore requires tests for these newly normative behaviors.

Several normative clauses still lack a corresponding WHEN/THEN scenario, contrary to the review rule: codebase-analysis has no scenario proving --tree avoids page rendering/network access, uses only the standard library, applies the required line format to every emitted node, or resolves an exact file path; skill-workflow has no scenario for placing visuals next to supporting text or for directly avoiding assert_required_keys_present. Add scenarios and assign their tests in tasks.md.

Every non-call-tree form is required to emit `Grounding: source read, unverified (form not graph-backed)`, but the workflow never requires source to be read before producing such a form. A response based on supplied context or model knowledge would therefore make a false provenance claim. Require a source read for this path or use a disclosure template that does not assert one occurred.

The closed grounding-reason decision table does not cover failure to spawn/run build_atlas.py --tree or an unexpected --tree exit other than 1, 2, or 3. Those failures occur after a fresh check but provide no permitted ungrounded reason or mandated fallback, so the skill cannot satisfy the exactly-one-disclosure contract. Define this path explicitly, such as mapping tree invocation failures to graph check failed, and add a scenario.
